head: 969743e15fd0b342afafa2040106b2fe3619bd52
purpose: Read-only code and report verification for a prospective plan; no compilation, new benchmark or algorithm edits
verified_facts: Failed wire3 supplies only upper in staged, then calls prepare_root(target,end,staged); prepare_root excludes target, omitting retained lower page from next root
root sentinel rejects empty binding vector or nonempty first lower; duplicate/non-increasing separators raise root bounds; std::map enforces unique keys
Current Page retains extract_split/apply_drop/block_for and scan reserve; index wiring rolled back; core not byte-identical to S0
Original fit(fences,1,7,8,1) differs from extracted-page/lower fit(fences,16,1,7,3); fit divides target rank by block_size
apply_drop erases vector elements but retains capacities and original arena; whole-index space effect must be measured
Failed wire3 does not update resident accounting for staged page and new root; map insertion success not checked; b==0 is coerced to1
U1 reasons diagnostic replays only insert records, so replacement delete/update semantics are not preserved
U2 diagnostic calls find_counted rather than public find_base and samples initial rows; directory-step ratio is not latency ratio
Microbenchmark uses old split_at_block removed from current Page; current two-phase method and complete insertion/root path were not timed there
Unit test covers standalone Page split and reads; does not validate integrated root/map, allocation faults or long-run maintenance
decisions: Keep Context16 default and stopped T2/free-list decisions
Do not treat sentinel fallback as sufficient fix
Register a finite integration cycle centered on route/ownership/publication invariants before an implementation attempt
Use actual eligible-operation time and fallback frequency to estimate end-to-end gains
